# WebMD

> > WebMD is a leading online health information platform providing medical content, physician directories, symptom checkers, and health management tools for patients and healthcare consumers.

WebMD serves as a comprehensive healthcare resource offering evidence-based medical information, doctor search capabilities, and health tools. The platform connects patients with healthcare providers while delivering trusted content on conditions, treatments, medications, and wellness topics.

## Key Topics

- WebMD
- WebMD Choice Awards
- physician directory
- doctor search
- healthcare providers
- medical specialties
- appointment booking
- hospital rankings
- telehealth
- symptom checker
- health conditions
- medications
- patient education
- wellness resources

## Find Healthcare Providers

- [Find Doctors Near You: Top Physician Directory](https://doctor.webmd.com/): Physician directory for searching doctors by specialty, insurance & location
